text:
**A.** Bill's signed and delivered deed was a valid lifetime gift. It made Bill and Kathy tenants by the entirety, so Kathy took the condominium by survivorship when Bill died, outside the will. Her prenuptial waiver only bars her spousal claims against the estate, such as pretermitted-spouse and elective-share rights. It doesn't stop her receiving a lifetime conveyance, so Tommy takes the pasture land and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 85
